scope: Frontend decision receipt retention and governed trading-intent readback, handoff and withdrawal.
acceptance: Confirm/modify retain intent_ref; confirm, modify, defer and reject use Agora write access.
Reload restores intent_ref from the persisted decision event and reads GET trading-intents/{id}, including lifecycle and handoffs.
Only shadow_start/shadow and paper_validation_request/paper handoffs; runtime rejects canary/live before transport.
Withdraw and handoff refresh authoritative readback; server allowedActions gate controls; no optimistic lifecycle success.
Per-event ETag takes precedence over queue ETag; missing version or loading/denied access disables mutations.
Decision/intent operations call only trading-room decision-events and trading-intents paths; existing persona consultation remains separate.
UI removes internal task code and states that no order is placed.

timeout 180 env VITE_BFF_MODE=live VITE_BFF_BASE_URL=https://api.dev.mvl-cap.tw VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false npm run build
